'''Simoom''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Simoom system/Legends|Simoom system]], within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="EAOC" /> that was [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Simoomian sensory hound]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Simoom was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA" /> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />

In the real world, a [[Wikipedia:Simoom|''simoom'']] is a hot, dry, dusty wind in the desert.
